name: Wish Acoustic
memo: Pink Floyd - Wish You Were Here: intro and verses. Acoustic-style 12-string strum, clean and open with a touch of chorus and room.

band.style_feel: slow, gentle strummed feel with soft brushed drums and a simple bass line, sparse in the verses
band.key: G major (intro riff around Em7 / G / A7sus4)
parts: Part A: intro and verses - quiet, sparse drums
Part B: chorus - fuller band, steady strum
Part C: solo section - open and spacious
band.tips: Tempo is about 60 BPM (some sources feel it as 120); the recording drifts slightly, so start the Trio+ learning after 2 bars of steady strumming. Keep the strum relaxed and even.

whammy.tuning: Standard (E A D G B E)
how: Leave the pedal off; play in standard tuning.
whammy.tips: The song is in standard tuning. No whammy effect is used on the recording.

guitar.position: any pickup, neck or middle on a Strat-style guitar, tone around 7
guitar.tone_notes: The recording uses real acoustic guitars (6- and 12-string); the amp's ACOUSTIC model approximates that on an electric. Roll the tone knob back a little to avoid harshness.

name: Wish Solo
memo: Pink Floyd - Wish You Were Here: lead lines. Gilmour-style Strat tone, warm crunch with delay and hall reverb.
